fusions.name: Sounding Chirps
fusions.desc: Sends 3 chirps through the water at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Sip
fusions.desc: Drifts you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then latches on for 12 damage. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Blubber Echo
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Thick-Skinned Dusk
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%. You have 8% dark resistance.
